definitions.explanation: To acquire knowledge or skills from a teacher or through study. Emphasizes learning from someone.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}を{習|なら}っています。
ピアノを{習|なら}いたいです。
{先生|せんせい}に{習|なら}いました。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{習|なら}う (learn X) / Xに{習|なら}う (learn from X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {習|なら}っている = 'is learning/taking lessons.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{日本語|にほんご}を{習|なら}う (learn Japanese)
・ピアノを{習|なら}う (learn piano)
・{先生|せんせい}に{習|なら}う (learn from teacher)
・{習|なら}い{事|ごと} (lessons/extracurricular activities)

Counterpart: {教|おし}える (to teach). Emphasizes learning from someone.
